ideas.title: Marble Run Special: Bounce Theory's first real long
ideas.hook: Swap 0-view compilations for one continuous marble race, the format at 2.27M views (21.7x) today
ideas.why: Bounce Theory's 8 longs top out at 114 views and numbered compilations fell to 0-11 (Long-Form Doctor). Today's trending pull has Marble corn's 'Marble Run♡Durururu Special' at 2,267,948 views (21.7x), another of its runs at 2.9x, and サマーマーブル's marble run at 1.06M (4.9x). All are one continuous course, not clips stitched together.
ideas.impact: A long format with proven demand: realistic first target 500-5,000 views per long vs 0-114 now, plus watch hours toward monetisation
ideas.effort: 4h to build the format, then automatic in the daily batch
ideas.script:
1. Add a marble_run long format to the Bounce Engine (sims.py): a tall procedurally built course of 12-20 sections (funnels, zig-zag ramps, spinners, trapdoors, a lift back to the top for lap 2), 8-12 named colour marbles.
2. On screen: live leaderboard, section counter, 'Final lap!' banner, winner card at the end. No cuts.
3. Audio: synthesized plinks per collision and a soft rising pad; no copyrighted music.
4. Length 10-15 min, 16:9, title like the outliers: 'Marble Run Special ♡ 12 Marbles, 1 Winner | Satisfying Marble Race'.
5. Run it as L1 for 7 days with different course seeds and colour sets; put the 3 best 25 s moments out as Shorts that say 'full race on the channel'.
6. Risks: render time for long physics; cap at 60 fps 1080p and test one 12-minute render first.
Worked if: in 2 weeks at least one marble long passes 500 views or beats every previous Bounce Theory long.

ideas.title: Keyword-first captions for every TikTok
ideas.hook: Fix the caption half of the reach drop in 10 minutes: keyword line, on-screen keyword, one question
ideas.why: TikTok views fell from ~700 to ~250 since Oct 21, and 15 of the last 20 posts end in 'Follow for more' (TikTok reviewer). Metricool's 2026 TikTok study says TikTok reads the first caption line, on-screen text and the transcript to file a video; question captions get 26.19% more comments, and like-CTAs cut likes by ~60%.
ideas.impact: Better topic matching and search reach; realistic goal is getting back to the ~700-view floor within 2 weeks (not guaranteed, since part of the drop may be account-level)
ideas.script:
1. Update the content-scripts skill so every script ends with a caption block: line 1 = the search phrase (e.g. 'stoic advice for young muslim men'), line 2 = one specific question, then 2-4 specific hashtags (no #fyp/#viral).
2. Add an on-screen text cue in scene 1 with the same phrase in the first 3 seconds, and make sure the phrase is said out loud in the first sentence.
3. Ban 'Follow for more' and any 'like if…' line.
4. Turn on auto-captions in TikTok and fix wrong words before posting.
5. Track the next 10 posts in the TikTok reviewer's table: views, comments, search share if shown.
Risk: the drop may be account-level (Oct 21), so captions alone may not fix it; the reviewer should keep watching.
Worked if: the 10 posts after the change average above the ~250 views of the last five, and comments rise.
ideas.buildPrompt: Help me (Omar) update my content-scripts Claude skill for my TikTok self-improvement page (young Muslim guys, Islamic discipline). Problem: my views dropped from ~700 to ~250 per video since Oct 21 and 15 of my last 20 captions end with 'Follow for more'. Evidence from Metricool's 2026 TikTok SEO guide (https://metricool.com/tiktok-seo/): TikTok weighs the first caption line most, reads on-screen text and transcribes speech; question captions got 26.19% more comments; like-CTAs were linked to ~60% fewer likes; use 1-5 specific hashtags, not #fyp/#viral. Change the skill so every script it writes includes: (1) a caption block whose first line is a natural search phrase for the topic, a second line with one specific question, and 2-4 specific hashtags; (2) an on-screen text cue in the first 3 seconds with the same phrase; (3) the phrase spoken in the first sentence; (4) a rule never to write 'Follow for more' or 'like if'. Keep everything else in the skill (scene format, VoicePrint pass, hooks) the same. Also re-create the missing hook-playbook reference file the skill points to, if you can see what it should contain. Show me the full updated SKILL.md so I can save it myself.

ideas.title: Weapon Ball Battle format for sims.py
ideas.hook: A new 'who wins' sim with HP bars, built once, remixable forever
ideas.why: Three small channels are 3x outliers with ball battles (Cell Wars Game 1,629 at 3.2x; Seadog Ball Battles 1,143 at 3.0x and 1,061 at 2.8x), and a character-ball 'vs' video hit 1,195,688 at 3.5x (Velique). ideas.script:
1. Add a 'weapon_battle' format to sims.py: two (later 4) balls bounce in a circle or square arena.
2. Each ball carries a simple drawn weapon (sword, spear, hammer) or shield, rotating with the ball.
3. Weapon tip hitting the other ball = damage; health bars at top; a hit flash and a synth 'clang' from the existing audio engine.
4. Last ball standing gets a 1-second slow-mo and 'WINNER' text.
5. Variables to remix: weapons, sizes, speed, arena shape, 'one gets stronger each hit'.
6. Title pattern: 'Sword vs Hammer... who wins? ⚔️ #shorts'. Use generic names only (no anime, Minecraft or game characters: copyright).
7. Put 2 slots in the 'winning elsewhere' block for a week.
Risks: fights that end too fast (tune HP so it lasts 20-30 s) or too random.
Worked if: after 7 days the median battle Short beats the channel's Short median.

brief.headline: Make Bounce Theory's long a marble race, not a compilation
brief.summary: Your best upgrade today is a Marble Run Special long for Bounce Theory: one continuous race is at 2.27M views (21.7x) right now, while your compilation longs sit at 0-11 views. For Ambient Escape, the top new lead is seasonal cozy-room longs (a winter library hideaway hit 27.5x). I hired a Caption Coach for TikTok, since your views fell to ~250 and most captions still say 'Follow for more'.
filmToday: Marble Run Special: Bounce Theory's first real long — paste its build prompt into a new Claude chat to get the marble_run_long code
notes: Answered team requests: TikTok caption data came from Metricool's 2026 study (question captions +26% comments); nothing reliable found on reach drops after ~300 posts. I couldn't find an English Islamic Shorts channel with trustworthy per-video numbers; today's Islamic lead is Arabic (event-timed hook, 159K).
Growth team: the pages ranking for 'marketing plan for a bakery' are per-business-type template pages (ClickUp), not generic generators; traffic numbers aren't public.
YouTube Shorts series (seasons and episodes) is rolling out since Sept 23: a tidy way to run a Bounce Theory tournament. The AI Opportunities team still hasn't run since it was hired.

formatLeads.name: Marble Run 'Special' (one continuous course)
formatLeads.howToMake: New sims.py long: one 10-15 min continuous course (funnels, zig-zag ramps, spinners, elevators) with 8-12 named colour marbles, a live leaderboard and a winner card. Synth plinks per collision, no compilation cuts.
formatLeads.why: The strongest long-form outlier in today's trending pull (and a second Marble corn upload at 2.9x, plus サマーマーブル's run at 4.9x / 1.06M). Long-Form Doctor found numbered compilations fell to 0-11 views; one continuous race is the opposite of that.

formatLeads.name: Guess the Song bouncing orbs (repeat winner)

example.title: Guess The Song// Satisfying physics simulation - 999 varied bouncing orbs
example.creator: Mo Lucky

formatLeads.howToMake: ring_escape/orb sim where each bounce plays the next note of a public-domain melody (Für Elise, Ode to Joy, Canon in D); title asks 'Guess the song'. Only public-domain tunes, synthesized by sims.py.
formatLeads.why: It repeats: Mo Lucky's second upload of the same format is at 264,263 (3.9x). A format that wins twice on one channel is safer than a one-off.

formatLeads.name: Every bounce = +1 ball (1 → 500?)
formatLeads.howToMake: Start with one ball in a circle; every wall hit spawns one more; on-screen counter races to a target (500 or 1,000). Same engine as brick_breaker, so it is a quick variant.
formatLeads.why: Small channel, but it is the same 'count-up to a big number' hook as the stacking lead and fits Omar's 20-25 s sweet spot. Test slot, not a proven slot.

formatLeads.name: Character balls 'X vs Y' (still rising)
formatLeads.howToMake: Two named balls (meme names, no copyrighted characters) in one arena with HP or size bars; first to escape or win. Already in yesterday's lineup, keep it in the elsewhere slots while it climbs.
formatLeads.why: Grew from 1.20M to 1.35M views since yesterday's pull, so the format is still being pushed.

formatLeads.name: Seasonal cozy room (winter library hideaway)

example.title: The Christmas Library Hideaway | Christmas Jazz, Snowy Village Views & Crackling Fireplace
example.creator: Tranquil Jazz Nook

formatLeads.howToMake: Pexels/Pixabay library or cabin-window clip with falling snow + his synthesized fireplace crackle and soft wind; title as a place ('The Winter Library Hideaway | Snowy Window & Crackling Fireplace | 3 Hours'). No Christmas branding and no jazz unless the music is CC0/licensed for monetised use.
formatLeads.why: Biggest ambience outlier in today's trending pull; the hook is a named, seasonal place, which Omar's sleep longs (0-4 views) don't have.

formatLeads.name: Autumn morning room ambience

example.title: Cozy Fall Morning Ambience 🍂 Autumn Sunroom & Fireplace | Pumpkin Bake Day
example.creator: Delger Family Farm

formatLeads.howToMake: Sunroom/porch stock clip, leaves outside, light rain + fireplace mix from his pipeline; morning framing ('for study and calm mornings') instead of sleep.
formatLeads.why: Second seasonal-room outlier in the same pull, so the seasonal-place pattern is not a one-off. Works now; switch to winter titles from mid-November.

formatLeads.name: Rain story short ('power cut, then the rain begins')

example.title: Power Cut on a Hot Summer Night 🌙 Then the Monsoon Rain Begins! | 90s Village Life #shorts
example.creator: Ghibli Village Stories

formatLeads.howToMake: 20-30 s Short with a tiny story arc: hot, silent night clip → first drops → full rain (stock clips cross-faded, his rain synth swelling). Text: 'The power went out... then the rain came 🌧️'. Avoid the word 'Ghibli' and any Ghibli-style imitation in titles.
formatLeads.why: A story arc on top of plain rain ambience gives a reason to watch to the end; works as a Short that points to the 3-hour rain long.

formatLeads.name: Nostalgic rainy-village night (story ambience)

example.title: 90s Indian Rural Life After a Storm 🌧️ | Pumpkin Curry, Puri & Dried Prawn | Ghibli Nostalgia
example.creator: Ghibli Echoes (via OutlierKit)

formatLeads.howToMake: Long rain ambience framed as a place and time ('A Rainy Night in an Old Village House | Rain on Clay Roof & Distant Thunder | 3 Hours') using stock village/rain clips; no faces, no AI imitation of a studio's style.
formatLeads.why: The channel has 354K subs and 1.8M average views with 8 outliers, all rain/village nostalgia. Data is from OutlierKit's page, not checked on YouTube.

formatLeads.name: Event-timed Sunnah reminder (rain dua)

example.title: كسوف الشمس ⚠️احذر من هذا الخطأ (Solar eclipse: beware this mistake)
example.creator: Basa'ir @alkamalii (via OutlierKit)

formatLeads.howToMake: On a rainy or windy day in Ontario, post a Short over his rain footage: 'It's raining — say this' + the dua the Prophet ﷺ said when it rained ('Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a', Sahih al-Bukhari 1032) with the reference on screen. Have the reference checked before upload.
formatLeads.why: The biggest Islamic outlier found today was tied to a live event with a 'do this / avoid this' hook. Rain is an event Omar can match to his existing rain clips. Note: Arabic channel; no English channel with reliable per-video numbers was found this run.

formatLeads.name: Quran story long (Ya'juj and Ma'juj, from Surah Al-Kahf)
formatLeads.howToMake: English narration (AI voice, never Omar's) over landscapes and wind, every claim tied to Surah Al-Kahf 18:94-99 and sahih hadith shown on screen; no depictions of people or prophets; checked by someone knowledgeable before upload.
formatLeads.why: Same channel as the 1.4M 'Day in Jannah' lead; its #2 outlier is a Quran story, so story longs are a repeatable pattern, not one hit.

tiktok.title: Keyword in the first caption line, on screen and said aloud
tiktok.what: TikTok reads the first caption line, on-screen text and the transcript to decide what a video is about.

evidence.title: TikTok SEO Guide 2026 (Metricool's 2026 TikTok study)
evidence.creator: Metricool
evidence.metric: 1+ hashtag ≈ +5% views; skip #fyp/#viral; keep 1-5 specific tags

tiktok.howToUse: Replace 'Follow for more' with a first caption line like 'stoic advice for young muslim men' and put the same phrase as text in the first 3 seconds; say it in the first sentence.

tiktok.title: Ask a question in the caption, never ask for likes
tiktok.what: Question captions get more comments; like-CTAs backfire.

evidence.title: TikTok SEO Guide 2026
evidence.creator: Metricool
evidence.metric: question captions +26.19% comments; comment CTA ~+14% comments; like CTA ~-60% likes

tiktok.howToUse: End each caption with one specific question tied to the script ('What's one thing you stopped controlling?'). Drop any 'like if…' line.

tiktok.title: Mention a relevant account (small accounts only)
tiktok.what: Small accounts that @mention someone relevant saw more reach.

evidence.title: TikTok SEO Guide 2026
evidence.creator: Metricool
evidence.metric: mentions: comments +45%, reach up to +20% for tiny/small accounts

tiktok.howToUse: Only when it is honest: credit the creator or page whose stat or quote the script uses. Test on 3 posts and compare views.
